data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD3: ci-llm-review-runner.sh reads size_action from the classifier JSON output; when size_action=upgrade, the runner routes to the deep tier model (same effective tier upgrade as local Step 3b).
- DD4: A diff of any size is reviewed without error — no hard line-count cap causes the runner to exit early or skip review.

## Implementation

File: plugins/dso/scripts/ci-llm-review-runner.sh

Step 1: Extend the python3 extraction block (currently at lines ~64-69) to also extract SIZE_ACTION:

```bash
read -r _SEC _PERF _TQ _SIZE_ACTION < <(printf '%s\n' "$CLASSIFIER_JSON" | python3 -c "
import json,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
print(str(d.get('security_overlay',False)).lower(),
      str(d.get('performance_overlay',False)).lower(),
      str(d.get('test_quality_overlay',False)).lower(),
      str(d.get('size_action','none')).lower())")
```

Step 2: After the overlay flag merging block and before the REVIEW_TIER assignment, add size-upgrade routing:

```bash
# Apply size-based tier upgrade (mirrors REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md Step 3b)
if [[ "$_SIZE_ACTION" == "upgrade" ]]; then
    SELECTED_TIER="deep"
fi
```

Step 3: Update REVIEW_TIER assignment and case statement — both already handle SELECTED_TIER=deep correctly; no changes needed to the deep-tier dispatch block itself.

The upgrade routing must be applied AFTER overlay flag merging (size upgrade is independent of overlay flags) but BEFORE the case statement that selects AGENT_FILE.

Note: REVIEW_TIER="$SELECTED_TIER" assignment at line ~89 will pick up the upgraded value correctly.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | grep -E "^(PASS|FAIL|Summary)"
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(bash plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && bash -c "$LINT_CMD"
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(bash plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && bash -c "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD"
- [ ] test_runner_size_action_upgrade_routes_to_deep_tier passes (GREEN — upgrade routing implemented)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh 2>&1 | grep "test_runner_size_action_upgrade_routes_to_deep_tier.*PASS"
- [ ] test_runner_size_action_none_does_not_upgrade passes
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh 2>&1 | grep "test_runner_size_action_none_does_not_upgrade.*PASS"
- [ ] test_runner_size_action_upgrade_large_diff_no_early_exit passes
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh 2>&1 | grep "test_runner_size_action_upgrade_large_diff_no_early_exit.*PASS"
- [ ] Existing runner tests all pass (regression check)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh 2>&1 | grep -E "^(PASS|FAIL)" | grep -v FAIL
- [ ] SIZE_ACTION extraction added to the python3 block alongside _SEC/_PERF/_TQ
  Verify: grep "_SIZE_ACTION" plugins/dso/scripts/ci-llm-review-runner.sh
- [ ] Upgrade routing applied before case statement (not inside a case branch)
  Verify: grep -n "SIZE_ACTION.*upgrade" plugins/dso/scripts/ci-llm-review-runner.sh | head -1

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Implement size_action=upgrade routing in ci-llm-review-runner.sh
